lines.text: Reference-typed sibling of `UncheckedSendable`. Lets a `@Sendable` closure
write a result that an enclosing synchronous scope reads after the closure
has provably finished (e.g. a `Task` whose completion is awaited via a
`DispatchGroup`). Use only when that happens-before relationship holds.
A renderer-neutral named cumulative count with bounded producer-defined keys.
A stable identifier for an AFMKit provider implementation.
Optional capability for providers that expose their model tokenizer.
Tokenization is intentionally separate from `AFMModel`: Apple's Foundation
Models API does not expose token IDs, while local providers such as MLX do.
Transports a value that the compiler can't prove `Sendable` across a task,
continuation, or actor boundary.
Used for Apple-framework reference types (e.g. `AVAudioPCMBuffer`,
`SFSpeechRecognitionTask`) that predate Swift 6 concurrency annotations.
The wrapper itself is `@unchecked Sendable`; correctness depends on the call
site genuinely handing the value off (no aliased concurrent mutation), which
is the case at every current use — values are produced, transferred once
through a continuation or single-consumer task group, and then read.
Provider-owned permission to execute one admitted generation.
Marks the lease as released when the provider's own scheduler has taken
responsibility for releasing the underlying capacity reservation.
Keeps capacity release with the caller while the provider takes
responsibility for recording the request's terminal telemetry state.
A renderer-neutral named floating-point gauge.
Optional capability for providers that can perform a small warm-up request.
Prewarming is intentionally separate from `AFMModel.load()`: loading makes
resources available, while prewarming allows a provider to compile or prime
its first inference path without exposing provider-specific runtime types.
Request-scoped generation values propagated without changing established
provider method signatures.
Enables or disables model reasoning when supported. `nil` preserves the provider default.
One immutable cumulative histogram captured at a metrics snapshot boundary.
A renderer-neutral named integer gauge.
Provider-specific values supplied by an application at model construction time.
Optional capability for providers that expose provider-owned admission state.
Capacity and queueing policies stay provider-owned. Hosts can inspect a
neutral snapshot without reserving scheduler-specific slots directly.
A default-provider telemetry endpoint that can be attached by a host after
provider construction without changing explicitly injected observers.
Optional capability for providers that expose neutral runtime telemetry.
Provider-neutral metadata attached to aggregate model download progress.
One immutable process-level inference telemetry snapshot.
Synchronous provider telemetry. Implementations must not call provider code or suspend.
Records cumulative prompt progress for a request. Repeated calls must
provide totals observed so far; observers account only for positive deltas.
Optional capability used by hosts to connect default provider telemetry.
